svg.title: The same inflow step at two levels
svg.desc: A 0.001 cubic metre per second inflow step raises the gravity tank from 0.25 metres to 0.3025 metres, where it settles; from 1.0 metres the same step raises it about twice as far, 0.100 metres in 199 seconds and still rising toward 1.1025 metres, and two thirds of the rise take 52 seconds instead of 27.
svg.text: The same inflow step at two levels: the tank answers differently
Control Studio project experiments · +0.001 m³/s at 2 s · outlet coefficient 0.020, area 0.5 m² · numbers answer the predictions
Outflow 0.0100 m³/s at 0.25 m: the level first rises 0.002 m/s
Settles at 0.3025 m: last 10 s 0.3020–0.3029 m
From 1.0 m: 0.100 m in 199 s and still rising,
about twice the 0.053 m from 0.25 m; 63 % takes 52 s, not 27 s
